The '''Gundarian Mining Company''' was a company. After being shot in the back and paralyzed from the waist down while he was posted on [[Carfoom]] a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] after graduating from the Space Academy on [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]], [[Jann Tosh]] took over the company.<ref name="Part 2" />
